The '''Rhuvia system''' was located in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Rhuvian fizz]].<ref name="YJK">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Return to Ord Mantell]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Rhuvian fizz]]|system=Rhuvia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
At some point by [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date SoR">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the majority of the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] take place in approximately [[3637 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "Astromech Revolt" is part of the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion and therefore also takes place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> several [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] serving aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of an individual in the Rhuvia [[Star system/Legends|system]] turned on their owner. A [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]] depicting the [[Droid/Legends|droids']] revolt later came into the possession of<ref name="Astromech Revolt">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Investigation|Astromech Revolt}}</ref> the future [[Alliance Commander|commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]],<ref name="Commander">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}} establishes that [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]&mdash;who becomes the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the future [[Eternal Alliance]] in "Chapter IX: The Alliance"&mdash;also was the player-controlled character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.</ref> who dispatched a companion to the system in order to investigate the event.<ref name="Astromech Revolt" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Rhuvia system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-5.<ref name="TEA" /> The system was later mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']],<ref name="Astromech Revolt" /> a [[2014]] expansion for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="SoR release date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20141202|text=Welcome to Shadow of Revan Early Access!}}</ref> a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="SWTOR base game date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111213|text=EARLY GAME ACCESS FOR THE OLD REPUBLIC BEGINS TODAY}}</ref> In the expansion, the Rhuvia system was used as a possible location for players to assign their companions on individual quests.<ref name="Astromech Revolt" />
